name: Test of Time (ToT)
description: Test of Time (ToT) is a benchmark consisting of novel synthetic datasets designed to evaluate large language models' temporal reasoning abilities across diverse scenarios. It enables systematic analysis of factors affecting temporal reasoning performance, such as problem structure, question type, and fact order.
reputation: A recent synthetic benchmark for temporal reasoning that is still emerging and has not yet become a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Synthetic datasets avoid pretraining data leakage and factual inconsistencies; open-sourced with evaluation framework.
